scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env staging --local
scripts.db:migrate:staging: node scripts/check-d1.mjs staging && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env staging --remote
scripts.db:migrate:production: node scripts/check-d1.mjs production && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env production --remote
scripts.build: npm run build:staging && npm run build:production
scripts.deploy:staging: node scripts/check-d1.mjs staging && wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.deploy:production: node scripts/check-d1.mjs production && wrangler deploy --env production
